verdict.rationale: Formant advertises natural-language fleet queries and an AI assistant for building dashboards, letting users 'ask your fleet what's happening in plain language' and receive ML-driven recommendations, but actual command execution still requires human approval and there's no evidence NL can directly issue commands (teleop, custom commands) shown elsewhere in docs as API/SDK-driven, not NL-driven. Missing for 10: documented NL command execution for robot actions, examples of NL replacing API/command workflows, and independent confirmation of AI assistant capabilities.
